cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Find the Real Authority
cards.instruction: Probe until you know who can approve, block, or reverse the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. The pipe's still leaking. Which signature releases the repair money?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: All three. I've spent all morning getting them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Could anyone still freeze it after your morning's work?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Finance could. Though they unfroze the roof payment when the caretaker called.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: What did the caretaker have: permission to overrule finance, or someone else's direct number?

mechanism: A approves further checks instead of release, probing the difference between formal signatures and the person who can reverse a block.
confusable: Generic bureaucracy would collect more forms; D54 seeks the actual approver or reverser, with A directing the investigation from above.
comparison: Repair funding follows a caretaker intervention, unlike the trip scene deputy authority despite possession of access.
seedUse: Use D54-b three signatures and finance reversal, with S01 approval governing the next inquiry rather than merely declaring control.
